name: Detoxcellence: Exposure Index
subtitle: Everyday exposures, sourced
shortDescription: Point at a pan, a container or a candle: its exposure score, studies and a swap.
fullDescription:
Detoxcellence rates everyday products and habits by the avoidable exposure they add — and names a cleaner swap for each.

POINT AND CHECK
Point the camera at a frying pan, a food container, a candle, a shampoo, a water bottle or a can: the app names the three things it looks most like, you tap the right one, and its Exposure Index entry opens. Where it matters it asks one question — which coating, what is in the can, organic or conventional. A room check reads one photo of a shelf and lists what it may show, highest burden first, with the top swap. Recognition runs on your phone; photos are never stored or sent.

THE EXPOSURE INDEX
189 entries across water, air, kitchen, plastics, food, personal care, home and environment: nonstick pans, plastic food containers, scented candles, tap water, canned food and more. Each has a Detox Score from 1 to 100 (higher means lower avoidable burden), built openly from three ratings — chemical hazard, everyday exposure and persistence — with the arithmetic shown. Each rating lists the peer-reviewed or agency studies behind it, or says plainly that it is unsourced.

WORKS OFFLINE
The whole Index is on your phone, so it works in a shop or on a plane. When you are online it updates from detoxcellence.com's open data.

YOUR EXPOSURE SCORE
Fifteen quick questions about water, air, cooking, personal care, cleaning and food give you a score out of 100 and the one change that cuts yours most. Every result is kept on your phone, so you can watch your score move as you make swaps.

A WEEKLY SWAP
Switch on the weekly reminder and pick a day and time: one swap from the Index each week, starting with the area your score points to.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos, answers, scores and settings stay on your phone.

Information, not medical advice. The ratings are editorial; every study and source is shown and the data is open (CC BY 4.0).

Built by JukkaBlomberg.com — one founder, an AI-native team, on Portfolio OS. More apps at jukkablomberg.com/apps.
promotionalText: Point the camera at a pan, a food container, a candle or a shampoo and see its Detox Score, the studies behind it and a cleaner swap. Works offline.
reviewNotes: Native features: (1) exposure lookup offline — the whole Exposure Index (189 entries, each with its Detox Score, studies and swap) is bundled; try airplane mode, then the Index tab and any entry; (2) swap reminders — Swaps tab → switch on Weekly swap reminder, pick a day and time; the app schedules local notifications on the device (no push server), each naming one swap and opening its entry when tapped; (3) score history — Score tab → Start the Exposure Score (15 questions); each result is saved on the device with its date and listed under Your history. Also: the Scan tab (first screen) recognises everyday products with an on-device image model — tap the target, allow the camera, photograph a frying pan, a plastic food container, a candle or a shampoo bottle, then tap the matching choice; the photo is classified on the device and deleted, nothing is uploaded. No account, no sign-in, no in-app purchase, no advertising, no analytics. Health information: educational ratings of avoidable everyday exposure with the studies shown; not a medical device; no diagnosis or treatment. Contact: Jukka Blomberg, hello@jukkablomberg.com.
firstScreenDisclosure: Information, not medical advice. Ratings are editorial and every source is shown.
